test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'RAJU' is written as 'WFOZ' and 'SITA' is written as 'XNYF'. How will 'MONU' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/744423f8add1e6dfecffcbb518ee3a342f4f30b3c37b9818db13e9942b7d2607.png] 

'RAJU' is written as 'WFOZ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aedf1a0306353647ab1c0823d99741f9d3553403d94f9f82e971e3a3f69eeaea.png] 

and 

'SITA' is written as 'XNYF'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06a8a9d87c5249f16ac5a4a18bad680a177c214f948a76df47b2fbcd1432d277.png] 

Similarly,

'MONU' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/377654ee18f08238f9ae6b38734993f05bb7a711349fa4380380632d9e3dcd6f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"RTSZ".**
tags: Coding and Decoding By Letter Shifting
